core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Music Studio aesthetics with Legal Precision.
Emotion First: The app should feel like a 'Safe Creative Space' (Dark, Private, Focused).
Content is King: Lyrics and Splits are the heroes. Everything else is support.
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark mode. Neon accents for 'Live' states.
anti_patterns: No center-aligned hero sections without tension.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Variant (Creative Authority + Legal Precision)

mono.usage: Lyrics Editor, Legal Clauses, Timestamps, Splits

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&family=Syne:wght@700;800&display=swap');

primary.description: Electric Amber - Represents 'Gold Record' standard and Pro status.

secondary.description: Recording Red - Used for 'Live' states, recording indicators, and critical alerts.

accent.description: Creative Purple - Subtle glows for creative flow states.

spacing_system.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for section padding.

landing_page.rules: Asymmetry is key. Use col-span-7 and col-span-5 pairings.

dashboard.type: Mode B: The Control Room Grid
dashboard.rules: Dense, functional. Sidebar (2), Main Editor (7), Tools/Chat (3).

buttons.style: Sharp edges or minimal rounded-md (2px). No pill shapes for main actions.
buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

cards.style: Flat, dark backgrounds with subtle 1px borders. No heavy shadows.

inputs.style: Minimalist, bottom-border only or flat filled.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays on the background to prevent 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) for floating panels (lyrics tools, chat).
visual_enhancers.borders: The 'Tracing Beam' effect for the Pro Plan pricing card.

hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy overlay

creative_process.alt: Songwriter with guitar in dark room

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a 'Pro' tool, not a toy. Keep it serious, fast, and responsive.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Ensure 'dark' class is applied to the html/body tag by default. The app is dark-mode first.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_customization: Go into /components/ui and strip out the default 'radius-md' and 'border-input' if they look too generic. Make borders darker (border-white/10).
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_implementation: Use the 'Control Room Grid' for the main app layout. Sidebar on left (collapsible), Lyrics in center (large), Tools on right.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles).

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
